author: Bellular News
description:
Creative Assembly are suddenly sounding very... honest? The 40k builds they stream are months old, and they tell you so. Medieval 3's starting factions are going to a player vote. They've watched Paradox win players this way for years, and after the decade Total War just had, they need every fan they can get. Why? Their sales simply collapsed.

Join us at http://bellular.games for early access content, 20 editions of 'Loading Screen' a month and to support our team!
